caption: The drawing depicts a metallic horse figurine standing on a rectangular base. The horse is posed with its front right leg raised and its head turned slightly to the left. The overall color of the figurine is a brownish-bronze with areas of yellowish highlights, mimicking a shiny metallic surface. The mane and tail are sculpted with visible texture, and the tail has a distinct bend to the right. The horse has a circular indentation on its torso. The nostrils and mouth include reddish coloration. The rectangular base supporting the horse is colored in similar brown and bronze shades and has simple, straight edges. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or features.
title: Rearing Horse Bank
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
